user.title: Add an AI pool
user.description: A pool publishes one entity that routes calls across several providers.

members.title: Members and policy
members.description: Members are tried in the order the strategy decides. A failing member is skipped and the next one is tried.

data.timeout_seconds: Give up on a member after

data_description.timeout_seconds: How long to wait for one member before abandoning it and trying the next. 0 waits forever.

limits.title: Allowances
limits.description: Declared allowances per member for {members}: requests per day, then requests per minute. Use 0 where the limit is unknown. Providers do not report remaining quota, so these numbers only steer the rotation — a real refusal is always detected from the error. Google publishes no fixed figures and does not guarantee them: read your own in AI Studio, and note they apply per project rather than per API key.

abort.already_configured: A pool of that type already fronts exactly these members. Two pools over the same members each keep their own counters and each believe they hold the whole allowance.

init.title: Members and policy
init.description: The pool type cannot be changed after creation.

data_description.timeout_seconds: How long to wait for one member before abandoning it and trying the next. 0 waits forever.

error.duplicate_members: Another pool already fronts exactly these members, and two pools over the same members would each spend the allowance as if they were alone.

duplicate_model.title: Members of {pool} share a model
duplicate_model.description: Several members of {pool} are backed by the same model: {models}. A capacity refusal comes from the model rather than from the account, so those members fail together and the pool cannot route around it. Point them at different models, or remove the duplicates.

reset_member.name: Reset a member
reset_member.description: Clear the cooldown, the spent-allowance mark and the permanent disable held against a pool member, so it is tried again immediately.

pool.name: Pool
pool.description: Which pool the member belongs to.

member.name: Member
member.description: The member entity to reset. Leave empty to reset every member of the pool.

clear_counters.name: Also clear today's counters
clear_counters.description: Lift an allowance the pool counted as spent, by forgetting how much the member has done today. Costs that member's metrics for the day, and is the only way to make it eligible again before midnight.

pool_not_found.message: No AI Pool config entry with id {pool}.

pool_not_loaded.message: The pool {pool} is not loaded, so it has nothing to reset.
